Welcome to National Mobility Command (NMC). To maintain realism and a professional reputation within the Truckers of Europe 3 community, all drivers must adhere to the following regulations.

🔰 SECTION I: GENERAL CONDUCT
1. Professionalism First: Treat all members, staff, and visitors with respect. Toxic behavior, harassment, or discrimination will result in an immediate ban.

1. Realism is Mandatory: We are a realistic VTC. Drive as if you are in a real vehicle.
( Keep top speed at 120 during convoy maximum)

No ramming or blocking roads.
2. Damage Control: Drivers are expected to keep damage to the minimum , Extreme damage is prohibited.
3. Activity: Drivers must complete at least 2 Jobs per week to remain active. 

🎨 SECTION III: COMPANY ASSETS & BRANDING
1. Player Tag: All drivers must add the VTC tag to their name in-game:
Example: [NMC] YourName
2. Official Livery:
Convoys: The official company skin is mandatory for all official events.
Freelance: You may use custom skins when driving solo, but the [NMC] tag must remain.

🛣️ SECTION IV: CONVOY PROTOCOL
Crucial for Multiplayer stability in Truckers of Europe 3
1. Distance: Keep a minimum distance of 50-80 meters from the truck in front to prevent lag collisions.
2. Overtaking: Overtaking is forbidden on single-lane roads unless the driver ahead signals you to pass.
